result.summary:
Re-gate after rework (commit 4724703f). All three acceptance criteria confirmed by direct source read of lib/letflow/identity/role_registry.ex (current HEAD dd4528a7):

(1) prefix = Keyword.fetch!(opts, :prefix) is bound as the first executable line in list_roles/1 (line 41), do_upsert_role/3 (line 94), and insert_or_update_role/3 (line 116) -- matching lib/letflow/identity.ex's convention exactly (confirmed against identity.ex's ~20 call sites, e.g. lines 224, 287, 327, 606, 688, 732, 780, 1102, 1198, 1216, 1285, 1616, 1737: always `prefix = Keyword.fetch!(opts, :prefix)` bound once, reused thereafter). No Keyword.get, no default value, no opts[:prefix] indexing remains anywhere in the file (grep-confirmed).

(2) Every Repo call site now uses the bound variable: list_roles/1's Repo.all(..., prefix: prefix); do_upsert_role/3's Repo.transaction(fn ... end, prefix: prefix) and its inner Repo.get(Group, group_id, prefix: prefix); insert_or_update_role/3's Repo.insert(..., prefix: prefix). No call site missed.

(3) Diff scope confirmed by `git diff --stat ade45ff0 HEAD`: only lib/letflow/identity/role_registry.ex (13 lines, +9/-4) changed in application code; the other three changed files are this run's own handoff bookkeeping (step-03-elixir-dev.json amendment, step-04b-security-reviewer.json, step-05b-reviewer.json itself). resolve_role_in_tx/1 is untouched, matching the task description's expectation. No new abstraction, no scope creep introduced by this rework iteration.

Could not re-run mix compile/mix test myself in this worktree -- `mix deps.get` has no network access here (consistent with README's documented environment limitation), same as prior passes in this run. Relying on ELIXIR-DEV's rework commit message (mix compile --warnings-as-errors: clean; test/letflow/role_registry_test.exs + test/letflow/routers/identity_test.exs: 83 passed, 0 failures) plus direct source verification, which is itself sufficient to confirm this specific, narrow, mechanical fix (variable binding + reuse, no logic change).

VERDICT: PASS. The single step-05 finding is fully resolved; the other four checks from step-05 (scope, resolve_role_in_tx/1 deferral, decision-record consistency, mix test evidence credibility) already PASSED and were re-confirmed not to be affected by this rework. Cleared to proceed to TEST-DESIGNER.
